title: Jumbo Chewy Dutch Knead Pudding
description: Pungent and chewy Dutch dish featuring raisins and kneaded dough, suitable for a date night.
instructions: Combine raisins, flour, sugar-free sweetener, and yeast in a large bowl, then add warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough with a wooden spoon or stand mixer for about 10 minutes, until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Roll the dough out into a thick circle and transfer it to a greased baking sheet.
Dust the dough with cinnamon and dot with butter.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Let the pudding cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, topped with additional cinnamon and sugar-free sweetener if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Jumbo Chewy Dutch Knead Pudding!
